a last round played the Battle Dome and Battle Palace double challenges and the Tower double, multi and Factory double formats; the confirmed misalignments are fixed and seen on screen before and after
crosscore_notes: VBA-M, gpSP and Mednafen-GBA draw every screen like mGBA; the few pixels left are the clock (the start menu shows the time, and each core's clock started at a different second) and an animation frame. VBA-Next has no real-time clock, so the game shows its standard "internal battery has run dry" notice and the rest of the script lands on other screens; that notice is drawn correctly in Hebrew. SkyEmu crashes the minimal libretro frontend on the English ROM too, so it was not compared. The title frame differs on every core because the intro animation runs at a different point when the save loads.

map_walk.held_reason: because the map starts a scripted Frontier or multi-battle sequence that the walker (which answers every prompt with B) cannot finish
map_walk.hebrew_only_reason: hold because the first Battle Arena battle was won in this run and the walker stopped at the next-opponent menu, which is drawn correctly; in the English run that battle ended back in the lobby

known_issues_intro: The decisions behind the translation are in `translation/hebrew/DECISIONS.md` of the source fork.
known_issues: Battle Frontier, Battle Tent and Trainer Hill trainers speak in Easy Chat phrases. About half of the Easy Chat words are still English, so many of these lines mix English and Hebrew words and read out of order (for example 'TOO MUCH קניות'). Whether Easy Chat is translated in full or kept English is not decided yet.

Summary screen: in a nickname with a geresh (ג'ימי), the geresh touches the bottom of the portrait box. The name sits between the box and the frame below it with 13 rows to spare, and a name with a quote mark needs 14 for a gap on both sides, so no position clears both.
EXEGGUTOR-A is אקזגיוטר-א, without the ק of the base form אקזגקיוטר, because the base form plus -א does not fit the 50 px Pokédex list column.

A woman trainer who withdraws a Pokémon in battle is described with the masculine verb, and Ariana's class name מנהל רוקט is masculine because she shares the class with Archer, Proton and Petrel (DECISIONS.md Q123, Q124).
Battle Dome results window: the 'סה”כ אליפויות' count sits 29 px right of the streak counts above it instead of in the same number column.
not_tested: Real hardware. No flashcart was available. The ROM is 32 MiB and needs a cart that supports 32 MiB images, with the save type set to FLASH 128 KB and a working RTC.
Playing by hand in a GUI. Every run above was automated. The tours type a Hebrew name and walk through menus and battles, but nobody played from a new game to the first badge.
A real 2.0.x save from a long playthrough. The save ladder was built with the harness and the debug menu.
Link features: trading, link battles, the Union Room, mixing records, the Wireless Adapter. The Hebrew Union Room strings were never seen on screen.
Link-only screens (trading, link battles, the Union Room, record mixing): they need a second GBA. Their strings passed the width audit but were not seen.
C strings in screens no tour opens: their budgets were checked against the code by reviewers, not on screen.
Female address. The player is addressed in the masculine throughout (a decision of this translation).
The randomizer and challenge options beyond their menus.
Easy Chat words, which stay English on purpose (the keyboard indexes them by letter).
Cores other than the six listed, and RetroArch builds for Android or handhelds.

Most of the 525 item plural names. The bag, PC, Pyramid and mart count lines were seen on screen with a sample of them, the longest names and the widest counts; the rest were checked against the glossary rules and by tools/hebrew/plurals.py, which fails when a stackable item has no plural.

Names of Pokémon from Gen 4 on, and many trainer names, are transliterations marked "proposed" in the glossary. All 1,851 were reviewed against the transliteration rules, the official English pronunciation and consistency with related names, and 22 of the 23 changes it proposed were made (`translation/hebrew/DECISIONS.md`), but none was checked against an official Hebrew source or by a native speaker on screen.
